A separate Nathan Direct projection-angle seed contains ten verbatim direct user-role messages from two archived conversations; its four-page PDF is also compiled and indexed. A private machine seed is present with a README reporting 69 equation occurrences, 15 source documents and six sector-document mappings; gzip/JSON integrity validation is in progress. Coverage remains incomplete; equation inclusion does not promote a theory claim or imply physical validation.
